propositions: The resolver canonicalizes openai specs to 'openai-chat:' qualifier but the live external tier's credential map lacks 'openai-chat' entry, causing live_llm_ready() to return False and all live LLM tests to skip on the openai arm

The provider guard at test_provider_matrix_live.py:88 makes literal startswith comparisons against REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER='openai' but configured_provider() returns the canonicalized qualifier 'openai-chat', triggering a false-positive AssertionError

The unit-tier matrix gate (_MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER) was updated in commit 8f4c5fdb0d3 to map qualifiers to provider families but the live external tier's consumers (credential lookup, guard assertions) were not updated

The fix adds qualifier->family mapping (_PROVIDER_FAMILY_BY_QUALIFIER) and provider_family() helper in tests/external/_live_llm.py so configured_provider() returns the family name, aligning credential lookup and guard logic
Unit regression tests must verify that configured_provider() returns the family 'openai' and live_llm_ready() is True when the openai overlay and OPENAI_API_KEY are present
The guard must retain its enforcement that a model class resolving to a different provider family (e.g. anthropic on the openai arm) still fails validation
